top_signals.title: Thailand SEC proposes retail access to regulated overseas crypto derivatives
top_signals.summary: Thailand’s SEC seeks comments on rules requiring retail-accessible overseas crypto derivatives to trade on qualifying, centrally cleared exchanges.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: India Stock Auction Needs Market Makers as Price Swings Persist
top_signals.summary: India’s new closing system absorbed a record $4.2 billion of stock trades linked to MSCI Inc. index rebalancing on Monday. Yet the sharp price swings that have plagued it since launch persisted, underscoring a key challenge to its long-term success: the lack of market makers.

top_signals.title: Japan’s 10-Year Bond Yield Hits 3% for First Time Since 1996
top_signals.summary: Japan’s 10-year government bond yield touched 3% for the first time this century, an important milestone for a debt market that is returning to normality after benchmark borrowing costs languished near zero for years.

top_signals.title: Japan 10-Year Bond Sale Demand In Line With 12-Month Average
top_signals.summary: Japan’s 10-year government bond auction drew demand that was in line with its 12-month average as high yields attracted investors.
